Quick Question. So I believe that when we reached 327,680 active validators the limit for how many validators can be activated per epoch increased from 4 to 5. Does anyone know what the number was prior to this? I.e. from 0-327,680 active validators was it always 4 validators activated per epoch, or has it been increasing from say e.g. at 20,000 active validators it was 1 activated per epoch? If this belongs in any other channel pls lmk always 4 until this adjustment Great, thanks see here https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#get_validator_churn_limit `MIN_PER_EPOCH_CHURN_LIMIT == 4` thus it is the minimum no matter the validator count then at this threshold it starts scaling upward <#598292067260825641> or <#595701173944713277> are probably a more appropriate for this general question Thanks very much for the help, any further qs I'll drop in these channels Do you have test cases for that <@291925846556540928> ? Not that westart having a consensus issue this close to the merge yes a few months ago we released tests and did a manual review of all clients on this case tests added here https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2586 and the manual review notes https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YKV55WHQVwr6U9qDZYgWSDGLfpw1mPPL0An8z3Vvn5Q/edit Speaking to mev boost has there been any consideration to invite the other mev companies to join testing besides Flashbots? I assume they have competing mev implementations for pos and technically more of the network currently runs Eden’s code than flashbots. Flashbots wasn’t “invited”: they basically just started working on their spec. I would expect other serious MEV providers to also be thinking about how to handle things post-merge Thank you for the response

excerpts.author: benharvey.eth
excerpts.content:
Hey guys! Quick Question. So I believe that when we reached 327,680 active validators the limit for how many validators can be activated per epoch increased from 4 to 5. Does anyone know what the number was prior to this? 

I.e. from 0-327,680 active validators was it always 4 validators activated per epoch, or has it been increasing from say e.g. at 20,000 active validators it was 1 activated per epoch?

If this belongs in any other channel pls lmk

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: always 4 until this adjustment

excerpts.author: benharvey.eth
excerpts.content: Great, thanks

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: see here https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#get_validator_churn_limit

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: `MIN_PER_EPOCH_CHURN_LIMIT == 4` thus it is the minimum no matter the validator count

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: then at this threshold it starts scaling upward

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: <#598292067260825641> or <#595701173944713277> are probably a more appropriate for this general question

excerpts.author: benharvey.eth
excerpts.content: Thanks very much for the help, any further qs I'll drop in these channels
